item.text:
[P1] Preserve support for non-string names — greeting.js:2

Calling `name.toUpperCase()` before coercion throws `TypeError` for numbers. This breaks the documented `greet(42)` path and causes `greetAll(["ada", 7])` to fail when mapping the numeric entry. Convert the value to a string before uppercasing, if uppercase output is intended.

Overall assessment: the sole change introduces a confirmed regression in two existing test cases. No staged or untracked changes were present.
